text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Right at my limit... Even though some 
time has passed since the race ended, I 
still can't catch my breath..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, Taishin's run was incredible too, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That intensity made me really want to 
cheer for her!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I managed to win, but I was seriously at 
my absolute limit... Honestly, I'm 
surprised I even pulled it off...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But that spirit of Taishin's was 
truly, truly amazing...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...I need to do my best, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, is my next race decided yet? If 
possible, I want to run in a big race!"

Winning Ticket was visibly exhausted, but 
she certainly delivered results in this 
race.

"In that case, our next step is the grand 
stage that closes the first half of the 
Twinkle Series—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! A Grand Prix race! A ton of super 
powerhouse runners are bound to gather for 
it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, Taishin and Hayahide 
will run too, making it a fiery race just 
like the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheers! Everyone's smiles! Just 
thinking about it makes me tear up... 
waaaahh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do our best for the 
Takarazuka Kinen, yeahh--!!
